# Docker images the integration tests pin, one per emulator. The tests read them from here (TestImages in the
# test-jar of testcontainers-floci-core) and CI pulls the lines it needs, so each tag is declared once and no
# other file in the repository names a pinned tag. One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines are
# ignored. The library defaults stay the floating latest tag of each image. floci/floci uses the tag the other
# testcontainers-floci ports pin.
floci/floci:2.3.0
floci/floci-az:0.15.0
floci/floci-gcp:0.11.0
floci/floci-oci:0.5.0
